description: Pin every bunx-invoked quality-gate tool (knip, jscpd, biome) to the bun.lock lockfile so check:all is reproducible across days with no ambient version float.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed: --bun forces Bun's runtime over a Node shebang and MUST appear before the executable name (current `bunx --bun knip` already satisfies this). bunx checks the locally installed package first, so an exact devDependency resolves the local copy without an inline @version token.
Confirmed knip 6.24.0 is a real published version (the CAM-118 unblock pin). This is the exact version to move from the inline check-all.ts token to a devDependency.

jscpd dist-tag latest for the 5.x line is 5.0.12; `bun add -D jscpd@5` resolves this exact version. Native per-arch prebuilt: exact-pinning fixes the VERSION and the arch-appropriate prebuilt resolves per-arch, so determinism is per-version not per-arch (subsumes CAM-243).

Lockfile already resolves biome 2.5.1; the ^2.5.1 caret in package.json would allow an ambient minor/patch bump on a lockfile regen. Tighten to exact 2.5.1 so lint (which runs --error-on-warnings) cannot gain a new warning class ambiently.

userStories.title: Pin knip and jscpd as exact devDependencies and de-tokenize the gate invocations
userStories.description: As a maintainer of the quality spine, I need knip and jscpd pinned via bun.lock instead of inline @version tokens so that check:all resolves the locally installed exact version and never downloads a floating latest release.
acceptanceCriteria: knip is added to package.json devDependencies at the exact version 6.24.0 (no caret/tilde/range prefix). [oracle: file-assert grep -qE '"knip": "6\.24\.0"' package.json]

jscpd is added to package.json devDependencies at the exact resolved 5.x version (no caret/tilde/range prefix; whatever `bun add -D jscpd@5` resolves, e.g. 5.0.12). [oracle: file-assert grep -qE '"jscpd": "5\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' package.json]

The dead-code gate in scripts/check-all.ts drops the inline @6.24.0 token and keeps its `bunx --bun knip` invocation (the --bun flag stays and stays before the executable name, preserving the CAM-198/CAM-202 in-container Node<20 node:util fix). [oracle: file-assert grep -q "g('dead-code', 'bunx --bun knip')" scripts/check-all.ts]

The dup gate in scripts/check-all.ts drops the inline @5 token: `bunx jscpd --config .jscpd.json src scripts`. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "g('dup', 'bunx jscpd --config .jscpd.json src scripts')" scripts/check-all.ts]
No inline @version token remains on any gate command string in scripts/check-all.ts. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -qE "knip@|jscpd@" scripts/check-all.ts]
bun.lock has lockfile entries pinning knip and jscpd. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '"knip"' bun.lock && grep -q '"jscpd"' bun.lock]

The argv assertions in test/check-all.test.ts for the dead-code gate (knip, ~line 127), the dup gate (jscpd, ~line 134), plus the two assertion descriptions/expectations for those gates, are updated to match the de-tokenized invocations (dead-code args = ['--bun', 'knip']; dup args = ['jscpd', '--config', '.jscpd.json', 'src', 'scripts']). [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: package.json (add knip + jscpd exact devDeps), bun.lock (regenerated by `bun add -D knip@6.24.0 jscpd@5` -- do NOT hand-edit the lockfile), scripts/check-all.ts:89-90 (GATES manifest dead-code/dup lines), test/check-all.test.ts (dead-code assertion ~123-128, dup assertion ~130-135; the GATES manifest-length test ~54 is unchanged since gate COUNT/order/names stay the same -- only the args arrays for knip/jscpd change). Gotcha (patterns.md:436, gotcha in issue): the knip gate's --bun flag is load-bearing (Bun-runtime forcing dodges the in-container Node 18 node:util styleText gap, CAM-198/CAM-202); only the version SOURCE moves from the inline token to the devDep/lockfile, the --bun flag stays and stays before 'knip'. Bun docs confirm bunx resolves the locally installed package first, so the exact devDep is used with no @version token. jscpd@5 is a native per-arch prebuilt; exact-pinning fixes the VERSION and the arch-appropriate prebuilt resolves per-arch (safe; subsumes CAM-243). This is tooling/config only -- no src/ product behavior, no templates/ or vendor embed, so no embed-vendor drift check applies.

userStories.title: Tighten @biomejs/biome from caret to exact pin
userStories.description: As a maintainer of the lint gate, I need @biomejs/biome pinned exact rather than caret so that a lockfile regen cannot ambiently bump biome to a minor/patch that introduces a new warning class and fails the --error-on-warnings lint gate.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json devDependencies pins @biomejs/biome at exact 2.5.1 (the ^ caret prefix is removed). [oracle: file-assert grep -q '"@biomejs/biome": "2.5.1"' package.json]
bun.lock still resolves @biomejs/biome to 2.5.1 (unchanged resolved version; the tightening is caret-to-exact in package.json only). [oracle: file-assert grep -q '@biomejs/biome@2.5.1' bun.lock]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: package.json:20 (change "@biomejs/biome": "^2.5.1" to "2.5.1"), bun.lock (top-level range entry at line ~19 updates from ^2.5.1 to 2.5.1; the resolved 2.5.1 package entry is unchanged). The lint gate invocation in scripts/check-all.ts (`bunx biome lint --error-on-warnings`) is already de-tokenized and needs no change, so test/check-all.test.ts's lint assertion (~line 92) is unchanged. Sequenced after US-001 (requires) so the two lockfile edits land as separate reviewed diffs and do not race a shared bun.lock regen. Tooling/config only -- no embed-vendor drift check applies.
